task: R22-S1d period-correct same-binary CSI phase-vector crossover

previous_s1c_binary.comparison_policy: All seven S1d branches use this one rebuilt binary; do not compare its absolute support counts to the unavailable S1c binary without a matched control.

factors: CSI range-phase vector source (same ON / other ON / paired target-free OFF)
design.raw_phase_policy: For each ON input, retain the raw phase vector estimated from that same ON input in the same S1d binary run.
design.csi_phase_policy: Estimate same-SNR ON and target-free OFF vectors in this same binary run; cross-apply without using truth.
